newsitem.title: UK: Sears spoilt by offers for shoe units-paper.
newsitem.headline: Sears spoilt by offers for shoe units-paper.

text.p: British retail conglomerate Sears Plc has been inundated with offers for its footwear businesses which were placed in the hands of a company doctor in May, said an article in the Independent newspaper.
The offers include two for the whole group which spans Dolcis, Shoe Express, Shoe City and Cable & Co. One offer is from an overseas retailer.
The other is thought to be from a UK financial buyer,

said the article, sourced to the company itself. Sears has also received "hundreds" of expressions of interest for various parts of the business. But the company has not disclosed values attached to the bids, said the paper.
